description.p: Replaces the "View Graph" dialog of Nuxeo Web UI with a simple, modern and read-only workflow graph: automatic layout (top to bottom or left to right), themed cards, current step and its next transitions highlighted, steps already done and transitions already followed marked, zoom (buttons, keys, pinch), fit to screen and center on the current step. Server side: records the transitions followed by graph workflows (one audit entry on each document attached to the workflow per completed step), read by the graph from the audit of the document.
